brief.objective: Produce the minimum safe implementation. Reuse existing code whenever possible.

instruction:
MISSION: AUTONOMY_CHECK

OBJECTIVE:
Assess whether the Runtime is ready to continue executing the roadmap autonomously.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Analyze the current roadmap state.
- Determine the next pending mission.
- Verify that all prerequisites are satisfied.
- Identify any blocking issue, if present.
- If blocked, explain precisely why.
- If not blocked, confirm that execution can continue autonomously.
- Do not implement any change.
- Do not modify any file.
- Produce only an analysis and a final report.
